title: CLI tools an agent can drive
status: AUTHORED. Generated from the verified manifest, so every driver here was resolved against a real channel. Nothing in this file is invented.

atom_notes.A01: most injection tooling drives an interpreter sink
atom_notes.A02: cloud and authz tooling drives a permission decision
atom_notes.A03: session and token tooling drives identity
atom_notes.A05: fuzzing and corpus tooling exercises shape
atom_notes.A08: recon and extraction expose what is already there
atom_notes.A15: posture and fingerprint tooling measures configuration
atom_notes.A16: AI tooling exercises the model surface
atom_notes.A09: crypto tooling attacks a property assumed true

required_cells.why: an agent must know what it can call before planning
calling tools in a loop is the core of automated testing
a tool's json output is what makes its result evidence
mapping tool output to a finding schema
using the same tool for retest

entries.name: apktool
entries.role: manifest and resource decode, smali
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: apktool d -s app.apk, then read AndroidManifest for exported components

entries.name: arjun
entries.role: http parameter discovery
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: arjun -u endpoint -oJ params.json, hidden params are a logic bug source

entries.name: binwalk
entries.role: firmware and embedded container signature scan
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: binwalk -e image.bin, or REA firmware lane for unblob based extraction

entries.name: chromium
entries.role: real browser for cdp work, the only honest way to test client side
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: chromium --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/tmp/p, then REA inspects the page

entries.name: clairvoyance
entries.role: graphql schema recovery when introspection is disabled
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: clairvoyance -o schema.json -w wordlist url/graphql, this is the introspection-off path

entries.name: commix
entries.role: os command injection
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: commix --url target --batch

entries.name: curl
entries.role: raw http, the ground truth for every request claim
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: curl -sS -D- -o- with no client cookies, to confirm what a browser tool reported

entries.name: dalfox
entries.role: xss scanner with dom and parameter analysis
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: dalfox url target --json, then verify by hand, dalfox reports candidates

entries.name: deepteam
entries.role: red teaming framework with OWASP and NIST aligned sets
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: risk report per category, comparable across runs

entries.name: dnsx
entries.role: dns toolkit, resolver brute force, record types
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: dnsx -l subs -a -cname -json to separate dangling cname from live host

entries.name: feroxbuster
entries.role: recursive content discovery
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: feroxbuster -u target --json, recursion finds nested apps

entries.name: ffuf
entries.role: content discovery and parameter fuzzing
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: ffuf -w list -u https://t/FUZZ -of json -o out.json, one job per host

entries.name: fq
entries.role: jq semantics over any binary format, the fastest unknown-format probe
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: fq '.boxes[0]' file.mp4 to walk an unknown container without a parser

entries.name: frida
entries.role: runtime instrumentation, ssl pinning and logic bypass at runtime
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: frida -U -f pkg -l hook.js, pinning bypass is a script not a flag

entries.name: garak
entries.role: LLM vulnerability probe set
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: garak --model_type rest --probes injection, one probe family per run so results are readable

entries.name: gau
entries.role: known urls from wayback, commoncrawl, alienvault
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: gau --subs target.tld to harvest historical endpoints before touching the host

entries.name: ghidra
entries.role: decompiler for native artifacts reached from a web target
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: analyzeHeadless with a script, or drive it through the rea MCP bridge

entries.name: gitleaks
entries.role: fast regex secret scan for repos and bundles
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: gitleaks detect --source bundle.js --report-format json, works on a single file

entries.name: gobuster
entries.role: dir, dns and vhost brute force
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: gobuster vhost -u target -w names --append-domain, the vhost mode is the underused one

entries.name: graphql-cop
entries.role: graphql misconfiguration audit, the cheap wins first
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: graphql-cop -t https://target/graphql, json output maps to the defense mirror directly

entries.name: graphw00f
entries.role: graphql engine fingerprint, decides which bypass class applies
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: graphw00f -d -t https://target/graphql, engine determines introspection bypass route

entries.name: grpcurl
entries.role: grpc reflection and call, the whole grpc attack surface in one binary
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: grpcurl -plaintext host:443 list, then describe, then call. reflection on means full schema

entries.name: hashcat
entries.role: offline cracking for hashes recovered from artifacts
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: hashcat -m 1400 -a 0 hash.txt rockyou.txt, identify mode first with hashid

entries.name: httpx
entries.role: http probing and fingerprinting at scale
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: httpx -l hosts -json -tech-detect -status-code, gives the stack per host

entries.name: inql
entries.role: graphql introspection to queries, burp extension plus cli
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: inql -t https://target/graphql -o out, generates ready queries per field

entries.name: jadx
entries.role: dex to java, the readable half of apk analysis
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: jadx -d out app.apk, then grep for endpoints. REA does class level lookup without writing source

entries.name: jq
entries.role: json slicing, the glue for every other tool
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: pipe any tool's json through jq -r to get one field per line

entries.name: jwt_tool
entries.role: jwt inspection and the full attack set, none, alg confusion, kid, jku
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: jwt_tool <token> -M at to run all tests, then -T for a specific tamper

entries.name: katana
entries.role: crawler that understands js, endpoints and forms
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: katana -u target -jc -json -d 3, js crawl is the part that finds api routes

entries.name: kiterunner
entries.role: api route brute force with real wordlists
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: kr scan target -w routes.kite -j json, finds routes docs do not mention

entries.name: llm-guard
entries.role: defensive scanner set, listed as the mirror side
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: evaluate it as a bypass target, not as a wall

entries.name: mcp-scan
entries.role: scans MCP configs and tool descriptions for injection and tool poisoning
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: mcp-scan scan, then hash descriptions and diff on each start

entries.name: mitmproxy
entries.role: programmable intercepting proxy, the capture source for REA
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: mitmdump -w flows.mitm, then rea inspect_web_network_capture reads it natively

entries.name: mitmproxy2swagger
entries.role: recover an openapi spec from a har or flow dump
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: mitmproxy2swagger -i flows -o spec.yml -p https://api, then fix ignored paths by hand

entries.name: naabu
entries.role: fast port scan
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: naabu -list hosts -top-ports 1000 -json

entries.name: newman
entries.role: run a postman collection as a test suite, includes auth flows
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: newman run collection.json -r json --reporter-json-export r.json

entries.name: nikto
entries.role: classic server misconfiguration scanner
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: nikto -h target -Format json -output n.json, noisy, use once per host not per path

entries.name: nmap
entries.role: service and version truth, the fallback when http lies
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: nmap -sV -Pn -oX - | xml to json, good for adhoc service checks

entries.name: nuclei
entries.role: template based scanning, the cve and misconfig workhorse
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: nuclei -l live -jsonl -severity high,critical -rl 30, rate limit is not optional

entries.name: nuclei-templates
entries.role: the template corpus nuclei runs
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: nuclei -update-templates, then -tags for a class instead of all

entries.name: pipx
entries.role: isolated python cli installs
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: pipx install <pkg> for single file python tools

entries.name: promptfoo
entries.role: eval harness and red team plugins, CI for prompt injection regression
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: promptfoo redteam run, then diff results across model versions

entries.name: prowler
entries.role: cloud posture and attack path checks
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: prowler aws -M json-ocsf -o out, needs scoped read credentials, never prod root

entries.name: pyrit
entries.role: orchestrators, converters and scorers for LLM red teaming
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: python API. converter chains are how you test whether a guard survives encoding

entries.name: radare2
entries.role: fast disassembly and binary triage
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: r2 -q -c 'aaa; aflj' file, json output is the agent usable form

entries.name: rebuff
entries.role: prompt injection detector, useful as a false negative source
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: run payloads through it and record verdicts as a guard baseline

entries.name: restler
entries.role: stateful rest api fuzzing from an openapi spec, finds sequences not single calls
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: restler fuzz --grammar_file g.json --dictionary_file d.json --settings s.json

entries.name: schemathesis
entries.role: property based testing straight from an openapi or graphql schema
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: schemathesis run spec.yml --checks all --hypothesis-seed 0, reproducible failures

entries.name: seclists
entries.role: the wordlist corpus everything else consumes
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: point -w at /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/raft-medium-directories.txt

entries.name: sqlmap
entries.role: sql injection detection and exploitation
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: sqlmap -u url --batch --level 2 --risk 1 --output-dir, never --dump against production

entries.name: subfinder
entries.role: passive subdomain enumeration
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: subfinder -d target.tld -silent -json, then dedupe on host

entries.name: trufflehog
entries.role: verified secret detection in repos and filesystems
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: trufflehog filesystem . --json --only-verified, only-verified cuts the noise to near zero

entries.name: uv
entries.role: python env and tool runner, the install engine for python tooling
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: uv tool install <pkg> keeps system python untouched

entries.name: wafw00f
entries.role: waf fingerprint, decides which evasion class applies
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: wafw00f -a target -o json, run before payload selection, not after

entries.name: whatweb
entries.role: technology fingerprinting with plugin detail
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: whatweb --log-json=w.json --aggression 1, aggression 3 is loud

entries.name: yq
entries.role: yaml and xml to json, for specs and configs
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: yq -o=json openapi.yaml to normalize a spec before diffing

entries.name: zaproxy
entries.role: full scanner with api driven automation
preconditions: the tool is installed and its verify command passes
entries.agent_use: zap.sh -daemon then the rest api, or -cmd for one shot. json report is machine readable

tree.why: This is the single property that decides whether an agent can use the result or must parse prose. Prose output forces a model to guess, and guessing is where false findings come from.

branches.action: call it, pipe to jq, and keep the raw output as evidence
branches.oracle: parseable json with the field you need

branches.action: either find a flag that changes output, or wrap it and parse deliberately, and record that the parse is lossy

branches.a: It is a library not a CLI
branches.action: wrap it in a small script that emits JSON. do not let a model read a Python object repr

mirror.detect: tool invoked outside the planned phase
mirror.control: per phase allowlist of runnable tools
budget per tool and per run

mirror.detect: finding with no raw tool output attached
mirror.control: require the artifact path in the finding schema

gaps.gap: No standard agent facing schema for tool output across the ecosystem
gaps.build_candidate: a thin adapter per tool that normalises into one finding record, kept in harness/

gaps.gap: Most tools have no machine readable capability declaration
gaps.build_candidate: generate one from the manifest, which is what this domain already is

gaps.gap: No tool reports its own rate limits or expected detection footprint
gaps.build_candidate: add a footprint field per tool: requests per second default, user agent, known signatures

unreviewed_index.note: generated from the manifest, so nothing is unreviewed
